project_type: Full-stack web application - PHP frontend with Python AI backend being added
build_system: Docker/docker-compose for containerized deployment. No existing build system for PHP (vanilla PHP with Apache). Python backend uses pip/requirements.txt.
test_framework: No existing test framework. Python tests will use pytest.
test_command: cd ai_backend && pip install -r requirements.txt && python -m pytest tests/ -v
verification_instructions: 1. Install Python deps and run pytest for AI backend. 2. Run docker compose build to verify containers. 3. Verify the trained model file exists. 4. Run the FastAPI app and test endpoints with curl.
snapshot_or_generated_files: ai_backend/models/prediction_model.joblib - trained ML model file generated by training/train_model.py
setup_instructions: 1. pip install -r ai_backend/requirements.txt 2. python ai_backend/training/train_model.py (parses seed_sidata.sql to train model) 3. docker compose build 4. docker compose up
environment_constraints: Python 3.9 available on host. Docker available with daemon running. Open internet access for pip installs and Docker image pulls. No MySQL server running on host - will use Docker for MySQL.
contribution_requirements: Hackathon submission - must be containerized with Docker, have clear README with setup instructions, and demonstrate AI/ML capabilities with Fireworks AI API integration.
key_patterns: PHP API endpoints use header CORS setup, json_decode input, PDO database queries, json_encode output. SIDATA data is in SQL INSERT statements in database/seed_sidata.sql (3058 study programs with historical data 2018-2022 for peminat and daya_tampung, plus daya_tampung_2023). The existing predict.php uses a 6-variable weighted formula. Frontend uses vanilla JS with AJAX calls to api/ endpoints.
directory_structure: Root: database/ (SQL schemas and seed data), website/ (PHP frontend with api/, assets/, config/, includes/, pages/), StageArsitekturIntegrasiSistem/ (PDF docs). New ai_backend/ directory to be created with FastAPI app, ML training scripts, and Docker support.
